changelog:
v5.0.2 — Dialogue now plays in both ears

• Fixed: on movies, shows and channels with surround sound, voices and dialogue played mostly from the LEFT side, while music and background sound came from both. This was most noticeable with hearing aids, headphones and TV streamers. Dialogue is now centered and plays equally on the left and right.

• No settings to change — the fix applies automatically after updating.

Includes everything from v5.0.1: the channel surfing fix, Catch Up, and the redesigned movie pages.
